payload.summary: Ward mockups end-to-end suite: 15 assertion failures on its first full run, and it is selected by neither verify:ui path
payload.detail: FIRST FULL RUN OF THE chromium-mockups PROJECT. 2026-09-10 at 8b4b96fa9c, dev server, workers=1, 10.9 minutes. RECONCILED: 171 declared, 171 run — 151 passed + 15 failed + 5 skipped. Playwright exit 1. ⚠️ The harness reported 'completed (exit code 0)' for the same run because the command ended in echo; read the recorded exit= line, never the notice. ALL 15 ARE ASSERTION FAILURES — toHaveURL, toHaveCount, toBeVisible, toEqual, element(s) not found. ZERO browser-loss or timeout. That is materially different from the previously recorded state (2026-09-06: 78 tests, 1 failure that WAS a browser lost under memory pressure), so that old note does not describe this run and must not be used to explain it away. THREE ARE WARD. (a) ui-ward-referrals.spec.ts:1056 — the guard's own words: 'Home region (right edge 623 vs scroller 606)'. The LAST column of the queued referral table is clipped by about 17px at a 641px viewport, reachable only by scrolling sideways inside the table; the guard permits one such entry and found four. An ordinary narrow-window layout defect for a builder. 🔴 EXPLICIT RETRACTION, CARRIED HERE SO IT CANNOT BE RE-ASSERTED: an earlier version of this row claimed it was 'the predictable consequence of an APPROVED change', citing owner-ruling-2026-09-07-board-columns.md and its five new columns. THAT WAS FALSE AND UNCHECKED. Presentation, Review status, Plan, Bed number and Legal form expiry do not exist anywhere in src/components/ward-management/ and belong to the ward BOARD, a different screen; this table's columns are Referral, Tier, Since referral, Age band, Sex, Home region. On that invented cause the finding was escalated to the owner twice as a decision only he could make. It is not. (b) ui-ward-referrals.spec.ts:414 — 'fixture assumption: the seed's queued referrals, in the queue's own order', expected 0 received 2. (c) ui-ward-roles.spec.ts:559 — getByTestId('ward-ed-inbox-empty') not found for peel-ed; the handle IS declared and renderable at ed-screen.tsx:1305, so this is a STATE question, not a dead handle. ed-screen.tsx and ward-referrals.ts are claimed on the register by Ward Builder One, whose in-flight work splits ED-addressed referrals into expects versus in-department — named as a hypothesis with evidence, NOT a diagnosis; nobody has read that change. TWELVE ARE OUTSIDE WARD FLOW and need routing: ui-caring-contact-mockup (4), ui-tools-collapse (3), ui-tools-task-directory (2), ui-sidebar-live-mockup (2), ui-answer-chat-perfected-mockup (1). ⚠️ SCOPE: ONE run — no claim about stability in either direction, and policy needs three reproductions on one SHA before quarantine. Because test:e2e:pr takes --project=chromium plus the seeded project and grep-inverts @mockup, these failures may be weeks old; NOTHING HERE ASSERTS A RECENT REGRESSION. NEXT ACTION: owner deferred routing 2026-09-10.
